### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [ ] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [ ] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [ ] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

**Title: [Bug] Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration crashes on CUDA graph capture: 'lm_head_is_tied' not set**

  **Describe the bug**
  Launching google/gemma-4-12B-it with sglang.launch_server crashes the scheduler during CUDA graph capture with AttributeError: 
  'Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration' object has no attribute 'lm_head_is_tied', at gemma4_mm.py's forward():
  self.language_model.embed_tokens if self.lm_head_is_tied else self.lm_head. lm_head_is_tied is apparently expected to be set during
  init/weight-loading (Gemma4Unified is a tied-embedding architecture per docs), but isn't in this case — so the very first forward pass
  (CUDA graph decode capture at startup, before any real request) fails and the server never comes up.

  **Reproduced on both 0.5.18 and 0.5.19.**


```
  [2026-09-09 13:19:31] Scheduler hit an exception: Traceback (most recent call last):
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py", line 5584, in run_scheduler_process
      scheduler = Scheduler(
                  ^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py", line 553, in __init__
      self.init_model_worker()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py", line 1060, in init_model_worker
      self.init_all_cuda_graphs()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py", line 1043, in init_all_cuda_graphs
      self.tp_worker.init_cuda_graphs()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/managers/tp_worker.py", line 443, in init_cuda_graphs
      self.model_runner.init_cuda_graphs(
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/model_runner.py", line 1062, in init_cuda_graphs
      capture = capture_cuda_graphs(
                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/model_runner_components/cuda_graph_setup.py", line 249, in capture_cuda_graphs
      decode = capture_decode_graph(model_runner=model_runner)
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/model_runner_components/cuda_graph_setup.py", line 568, in capture_decode_graph
      runner = graph_runners[model_runner.device](model_runner)
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/decode_cuda_graph_runner.py", line 489, in __init__
      self.capture()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/decode_cuda_graph_runner.py", line 1075, in capture
      self._capture_one_stream()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/decode_cuda_graph_runner.py", line 1144, in _capture_one_stream
      self.capture_one_shape(
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/decode_cuda_graph_runner.py", line 1262, in capture_one_shape
      self.backend.capture_one(
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner_backend/full_cuda_graph_backend.py", line 110, in capture_one
      forward_fn()
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/decode_cuda_graph_runner.py", line 1223, in run_once
      out = forward(
            ^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/torch/utils/_contextlib.py", line 124, in decorate_context
      return func(*args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/models/gemma4_unified.py", line 234, in forward
      out = super().forward(*args, **kwargs)
            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/torch/utils/_contextlib.py", line 124, in decorate_context
      return func(*args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sglang/srt/models/gemma4_mm.py", line 685, in forward
      self.language_model.embed_tokens if self.lm_head_is_tied else self.lm_head
                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    File "/home/jovyan/home/jovyan/avbezborodov/memory-utils/venvs/sglang/lib/python3.11/site-packages/torch/nn/modules/module.py", line 1967, in __getattr__
      raise AttributeError(
  AttributeError: 'Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration' object has no attribute 'lm_head_is_tied'
```


  Additional context
  Looks related to #31236 ("'Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration' object has no attribute 'get_embed_and_head'") — same family of bug: an
  attribute the Gemma4(Unified) forward path expects from init/load_weights() (tied-vs-untied lm_head bookkeeping) isn't actually set under
  some code path. Gemma4 support looks still fresh in sglang (#26596, #27261), so this may be another gap in that same bookkeeping,
  triggered via CUDA graph capture instead of quantized loading.

### Reproduction

  python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path google/gemma-4-12B-it --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30011 --tp 1
  No quantization, no extra flags beyond --tp 1

### Environment
  - sglang: 0.5.18 and 0.5.19 (both fail identically)
  - Python: 3.11
  - Model: google/gemma-4-12B-it, full precision, --tp 1
  - GPU - NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3
- torch: Version: 2.13.0
